# Lessons from running 8 years of on-call rotations

By Aiden Halvorsen, Coordinator

Published January 5, 2026

When we first set up on-call, everyone dreaded it. Over time we learned three things that made it sustainable: keep alerts actionable, write short runbooks, and rotate fairly.

**1. Alerts should be actionable.** If nobody knows what to do when a page fires, delete the alert or fix the runbook.

**2. Runbooks beat heroics.** A ten-line checklist saves more time than a brilliant engineer at 3 a.m.

**3. Rotate fairly.** Share the load, and always compensate people for their time.
